confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of central Vietnam tourist pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable; cocktail and wine are less certain and were set from the typical tourist-bar multiple of beer, as direct knowledge is weak. Accommodation is the least certain, and July is peak season in Hoi An, so rates may run high. FX observation was taken from a search-result excerpt of the RBA overview page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other central Vietnamese tourist towns and cities such as Da Nang, Hue and Nha Trang, adjusted for Hoi An's heritage-town tourist premium, with some reference to general Southeast Asian tourist-town pricing.
